title: Grateful Dead Live at State Fairgrounds on 1980-09-06
source: Recording by Steve Rolfe & Jim Wise: Master Audience Cassette; 2 NaKamichi 700s> Sony D-5; Transfer and FLAC encoding by David Minches: February 20 , 2014; Master played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Korg MR-1000(DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo]) Korg AudioGate > WAV [24/96] > Adobe Audition 3.0> FLAC encoding

ai_review.summary: Excellent recording that can be EQ‑tuned to perfect clarity; no specific show details were provided.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the tape’s overall fidelity, noting that while there is some sibilance and muted highs in the 7 kHz range, a simple EQ adjustment restores full sparkle and allows loud playback without distortion. No comments on the musical performance are given, so the show quality remains unassessed.

ai_rating.rationale: A single five‑star review highlights a high‑quality recording that can be easily corrected with EQ, but offers no insight into the performance; thus rating leans heavily on recording quality with moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slight sibilance around 7 kHz and muted highs noted, but can be fully corrected with EQ; playback remains clean at high volume.
